comment: What the game draws and plays for each thing the simulation has: game IDs on the left, the asset pipeline's stable semantic IDs on the right.
Presentation data, not game content: nothing here changes a rule, a save or the content hash. An asset that is missing or will not load
falls back to its greybox. Every model is drawn at its authored size (the asset's semantic size is authoritative; nothing rescales
one to a collision shape): centred on its structure, its long side along the structure's, stood on the ground. Where the authored
size and the world's structure disagree by more than half a metre a side (or 0.6 m of height) the greybox stands and the mismatch
is reported. 'tile' repeats a modular piece (a fence panel) at its own length. Static models are the full files: every _lod1-3 file
in the library (1,455) carries no material. Weapons are held by their own SOCK_grip_primary. Sources: assets/manifests/
playable_prototype_assets.json (the player, the weapons, the den chest), phase1_environment.json, ashen_hollow_landmarks.json,
Phase A: an overhang structure (a clearance) stands its model from the clearance up and measures it against its thickness; a node
may give a 'spent' model beside its ready one ('hide_ready' still draws nothing while ready); a station may give its own 'model', a
'beside' model at 'beside_offset', and a 'light'; a building may give its 'interior_light' (one or a list). A light is data: 'at'
[x, y, z] metres from what it lights (a station's feet, a building's footprint centre on the ground), 'colour' [r, g, b], 'energy',
'range', 'shadows', 'size'. A person with no 'grip' holds by its rig's own SOCK_<hand> socket. Coverage: art_coverage_allowlist.json.

rock_foldscar_heart.note: DS Phase B (2026-09-27): the alien-artifact stand-in is retired. This override names the same monument as the default binding so that no tier - including the High tier the game ships - draws the borrowed sculpture.

DS Phase B (2026-09-27): the Foldscar's own monument instead of a stand-in. landmark_foldscar_core is 'a ring of stones round a crater' but was authored with the ring standing on edge, so its crater faced sideways; landmark_foldscar_core_up is that same asset rotated -90 deg about X with its base dropped to the ground (G:/UNNAMED_DS_ASSETS/scripts/orient_foldscar_core.py), which is the brief's reading of the place. It replaces scifi_artifact_a, a borrowed OpenGameArt alien sculpture that every tier drew here under foldscar=proof.

rock_iron_seam.note: Phase B demo: the seam as a broken rock with a rust-red vein through it (prop_iron_vein_outcrop at the seam's size, prepare_scaled_variant.py), in place of the smooth Phase-A outcrop; the node's own ready and spent looks stand at its south face.

rock_rim_01.note: Phase B demo: scanned boulders (prepare_scaled_variant.py) in place of the smooth rim outcrops.

beam_woundmoss.note: An overhang (clearance 1.3 m): the model stands from its clearance up and is measured against its 0.4 m thickness.

den_rock_west.note: Phase A: the den's three rock masses, each built to its box.

tree_.note: The procedural species (oak, pine, dead: _procgen_tree.py) and their seeded variants (_b, _c: lobed oak crowns, a tall and a fuller pine, a second dead tree; docs/phase_b/demo/trees/TREES.md) at their authored 11.8-15.3 m, trunk vertical from the ground; weighted by repetition (Phase B demo): the Charwood mostly oak with pine, dead trees rare; the original ball-crowned oak once in nine (the birch model is left out: its far LOD is a smooth green blob).

interior_light.note: One warm lamp under the ridge, as a lived-in hall has (the visual audit's V1); at from the footprint's centre on the ground.

longhouse_.note: Drawn whole over its walls' footprint (the procedural lodge, built to these walls); the walls and roof stay the camera's colliders. Arrows striking it read as wood.

interior_light.note: A lamp over the anvil and the door, so the smithy is not lit by the hearth alone (Phase A: its interior read black in the delta shots).

emitters.note: Phase B (B11): smoke from the chimney top, measured on forge_shed's model

forge_.note: Drawn whole the same way (the procedural smithy, chimney over the hearth).

container.den_cache.note: The playable prototype manifest's den cache chest.

forge.note_bellows: No separate bellows: the hearth model carries its bellows pipe; prop_forge_double_bellows stays withheld (it reads as lungs).

light.note: The hearth's glow, whatever draws the hearth (the greybox hearth's own light, kept as data).

creature.beast.wolf_grey_alpha.note: The den leader (owner finding 29) is the grey wolf's own model at its own size: the view scales a creature by its body_radius_m, so the alpha's 0.58 m against the pack's 0.45 draws it 1.29x. A distinct coat would need a separate model and is left to character art.

creature.beast.wolf_grey.note: The wolves are the prototype's (not the bible's five): the frost wolf's body, and the hound's voice until a wolf set exists.

player_bodies.comment: What each body preset (content/bodies, body.<type>.<build>; WP17) is drawn with. A type lists its models, the first one installed drawn; the player is a MetaHuman (the MPFB player bodies retired, owner 2026-10-17) - male Veth the MetaHuman blend Victor x Trey (mh_veth_m), female Sunita x Tuya (mh_veth_f), owner 2026-10-15. Each build is its own model, baked with its garments by tools/character_build: <model>_<build>, base_build drawn by the model itself. A body whose model is not installed is offered disabled; there is no stand-in. body.default (every character made before the creator) keeps the body the run was bound with. The Kal, Siann and Orenth (playable from 2026-10-24) are drawn by their approved HumGen production bodies (Race_Bodies/production), one native shape a type until more builds are baked.
